create_EpisodeBatcher: create an EpisodeBatcher with n_timesteps, n_slots, agent factory, env factory, and thread count
execute_MultiThreadEpisodeBatcher: execute the MultiThreadEpisodeBatcher to distribute n_episodes across worker threads with agent and env info
get_MultiThreadEpisodeBatcher: get collected episode data from the MultiThreadEpisodeBatcher buffer with optional blocking behavior
run_MonoThreadEpisodeBatcher: run a MonoThreadEpisodeBatcher to collect episode trajectories from a single-threaded agent and environment
update_EpisodeBatcher: update all worker agents in the EpisodeBatcher with new training info
